status: declared: the inputs below are our F450 declaration, not yet reconciled with the F450 PteroSim flies (its JSBSim XML ships in the PteroSim release under PteroSimAircrafts/, readable only after the operator accepts the PteroSim EULA). Reconciling them is part of the PteroSim leg; until then the SIH leg flies this declaration.

provenance.diagonalWheelbaseM: DJI Flame Wheel F450 specification: diagonal wheelbase 450 mm (https://www.dji.com/flame-wheel-arf/spec).
provenance.takeoffMassKg: The midpoint of DJI's published F450 takeoff weight, 800 g to 1600 g (same page).
provenance.rotorUnitMassKg: Declared: one motor, propeller and arm ESC at each arm tip.
provenance.bodyBoxM: Declared: the rest of the mass as a uniform 150 x 150 x 80 mm central box (x forward, y right, z down).
provenance.thrustToWeight: Declared: a thrust-to-weight of 2 at full throttle.
provenance.torqueToThrustM: The magnitude of the rotor moment coefficient both PX4 airframes the cross-check flies give the allocator: 10016_none_iris sets CA_ROTORn_KM to 0.05, 0.05, -0.05, -0.05, and PX4 1.18.0 SIH (10040_sihsim_quadx) read the same four values back.
